exp.desc:
- Java and Python services
- Query optimisation: 4 s to 80 ms
- On-call, monitoring

cl.p1: our slowest query took four seconds and ran twenty thousand times a day. A week of query plans, two new indexes and a rewritten join brought it down to eighty milliseconds. That is the kind of work I enjoy most.
cl.p2: I have five years of backend development in Java and Python, mostly for billing and warehouse systems. I design clean data models, build APIs other teams like using, write tests before merging and have shared on-call duty. Your software runs warehouses with millions of transactions a day.

cl.p1: my final-year project was a payments service for a student canteen that records top-ups from an app without counting a penny twice. Idempotent APIs, transactions and tests with simulated network failures were at its core.
cl.p2: I write Go and Python. A fintech where every transaction has to be right is the place where I want to learn.
